_: Soul sand wears as sand (Xep, 2026-11-06: Let them wear). Named here because the rules refuse every block called soul and, from 1.16.5, every block short of its cell, and one block of the game's should not move that line for every mod's. Nether wart holds its square because it is planted there, as wheat is on farmland, and a path worn through a wart bed would otherwise break the crop. Mud wears as dirt (Xep, 2026-11-08: Vanilla mud wears as dirt), as the world-generation mods' muds of its class do; it is short of its cell as soul sand is, so it is named here for the same reason. Packed mud and muddy mangrove roots are not mud and are left to detection.

From the plain census of 26.3 (W4 R4, 2026-11-11), which left the same blocks as 26.2's with the same facts, so 26.2's entries as it judged them. Terracotta in every color, sandstone, red sandstone, obsidian, calcite and tuff are natural rock the rules leave out: terracotta, calcite and tuff have no stone word, and sandstone and obsidian are on the decorative list so that their bricks and made blocks stay out. The amethyst block and budding amethyst are the rock of a geode's wall, on a material no rule reads. Clay is packed earth of river beds and the moss block a living top over the ground of lush caves, both on a material no rule reads. The pale moss block is the living mat that is the pale garden's ground, worn as grass is, and on a material no rule reads as well; the pale moss carpet and the hanging moss over it are left to detection. Magma, both nyliums and soul soil are the Nether's own ground with no nether word, and soul soil is refused for the soil in its name. Basalt and blackstone are only ever the Nether's ground, and the rules read the stone in their names.

Cinnabar and sulfur are the solid natural rock of the sulfur caves and the ground beside them, rock with no stone word, so the rules leave them out; their polished, chiseled and brick blocks are made and left to detection, and potent sulfur keeps a block entity, so it is excluded and not named here.

Named one by one because any word a rule could read would take other mods' blocks with it, and because a file reaches a config that already holds detection's line where a changed rule does not. Stone stairs are made from stone in this game, so 1.7.10's cobble entry for them is not here.

Sculk is the deep dark's living skin and its own family (Xep, 2026-11-11: Add both families; 0.9.229, W4), judged so by this edition's plain census; its rut opens onto deepslate by the family's own list.

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 26.3 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was. Where an earlier note here leaves this mod's slabs and stairs to the rules, or to detection's family, the ones named below no longer are.
